commentary: Benchmark indices are staging a technical bounce, yet a breadth score of 33 confirms a deterministic WEAK gate. Stan Weinstein's Stage Analysis dictates that overall market health governs individual breakout probability; trading during compromised breadth demands strict defense. William O'Neil's CANSLIM market-direction rules require confirmed follow-through days and broad institutional sponsorship before aggressively committing risk capital. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure principles dictate keeping pilot positions small and dry powder ample. Until market breadth decisively expands and distribution days recede, focus strictly on high-conviction Stage 2 candidates displaying genuine EPS acceleration, keeping stop-losses tight and refusing to chase extended moves.

AMDIND.technical: Satisfies the Minervini Trend Template above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA [1.1.5]. Price cleared a 20-session consolidation to fresh 52-week highs on an exceptional 21.8x volume surge, demonstrating powerful institutional demand and high relative strength.
AMDIND.fundamental: Packaging turnaround showing aggressive operating leverage; Q1 FY27 revenue rose 41% YoY to ₹122 Cr with net profit surging 518% to ₹9.33 Cr as operating margins expanded past 15%. Low financial leverage aids bottom-line recovery despite modest historical ROCE.
AMDIND.risk: A close below the 55.95 pivot stop violates the breakout base; exit promptly to honor capital preservation rules.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Classic SEPA breakout clearing 20-session resistance to new trailing-year highs on 10.3x volume expansion. Price structure is stacked above rising 21, 50, and 200 moving averages, exhibiting genuine Stage 2 institutional accumulation.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals; Q1 revenue surged 111% YoY to ₹87.8 Cr while net profit climbed 151% to ₹27.4 Cr. Robust profitability metrics feature ROCE of 29.6%, ROE of 21.2%, negligible debt, and clean operating cash generation.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Violation of the 759.99 stop invalidates the pivot; execute swift loss-cutting to maintain positive risk-reward asymmetry.

BODALCHEM.technical: Constructive double-bottom formation following a prior 231% run. Price trades comfortably above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with MACD above zero; current 16.8% flag absorbs overhead supply efficiently.
BODALCHEM.fundamental: Cyclical chemical recovery gaining momentum; Q1 revenue expanded 56% YoY to ₹709 Cr with net profit surging 219% to ₹30.4 Cr. Ongoing benzene derivatives ramp-up and planned ₹150-175 Cr debt reduction support ongoing earnings power.
BODALCHEM.risk: A decisive break beneath 162.06 breaches double-bottom support; liquidate immediately without rationalizing.

CASHIETF.technical: Not an equity chart. Moving average crossovers and nominal breakout patterns represent mechanical accrual of daily repo yields rather than institutional accumulation or price discovery.
CASHIETF.fundamental: ICICI Prudential BSE Liquid Rate ETF is an overnight cash-management fund investing in collateralized repo/TREPS instruments. It carries no corporate earnings, revenue, or operating balance sheet.
CASHIETF.risk: Negligible capital risk, but carries 100% equity opportunity cost; exit if deploying into true Stage 2 growth setups.

CEIGALL.technical: Constructive 23.2% deep base with a tight 3.3% handle below the 406.11 pivot. Price holds above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with positive momentum, setting up a potential Stage 2 continuation.
CEIGALL.fundamental: Solid civil infrastructure player generating 16% revenue growth to ₹970 Cr and 18% PAT growth to ₹63.8 Cr. ROCE stands at a healthy 17.3%, but sub-25% EPS growth fails O'Neil's top-tier acceleration standard.
CEIGALL.risk: Breach below 379.81 violates the handle structure; cut losses swiftly per Minervini risk discipline.
